cves.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp 17c12da. The impacted element is the function Assimp::MDLImporter::GenerateOutputMeshes_3DGS_MDL7 of the file code/AssetLib/MDL/MDLLoader.cpp of the component 3DGS MDL7 Model Output Mesh Generator. The manipulation leads to buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Open Asset Import Library Assimp
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性
